nodes.name: consolidate_evidence_snippets
nodes.instruction_excerpt:
Consolidate the per-keyword passage searches into a single ranked
evidence set most relevant to the core claim.

Question analysis: {{question_analysis}}
Paper: {{paper_content}}

Use the keywords from {{question_analysis}} to identify which
paragraphs in the paper most directly address the core claim. Choose
up to 5 paragraphs. Each must be copied VERBATIM from the paper. Do
NOT paraphrase or invent text. Drop weak or tangential snippets even
if it brings the count below 5.

nodes.name: verify_evidence_quality
nodes.instruction_excerpt:
Sanity-check the evidence set before option evaluation.

Question analysis: {{question_analysis}}
Evidence so far: {{evidence}}
Paper:
{{paper_content}}

For each snippet, confirm:
- It appears verbatim somewhere in the paper text above.
- It is genuinely relevant to the core claim (not just keyword
  coincidence).
- It is non-redundant with the other snippets.

If any snippet fails verification, list it with a brief explanation.
Otherwise confirm the evidence set is acceptable.
